delivery: Warm, relaxed conversational product guide. Speak naturally, with gentle emphasis and room to breathe. No announcer voice.
product: Here’s Lotline. A clear place to plan your next contribution on Solana. Start with your portfolio. Your saved split is right here, ready for the next amount. Want to explore? Open Markets, find a company, and inspect the asset before adding it. Then head to the planner. Pick your assets, set your percentages, and enter your budget. Lotline accounts for every micro USDC, so the split adds up exactly. Example mode lets you practice with synthetic data. Live estimates come with their source and expiry. For supported stocks, Pyth adds price context and shows when a reference is too old. Community plans offer another starting point. Review a shared split before applying it; following a plan never buys anything. On your phone, the same workspace stays close through the bottom tabs. Save a reminder and come back when you’re ready. Purchases require supported routes, access checks, and your wallet approval. This tour moves no funds. Your next contribution, clearly.
technical: Here’s what sits behind a Lotline contribution. The budget becomes integer micro USDC. Percentages become basis points. Any remainder is assigned deterministically, so the final amounts match your budget. Example data stays separate from live providers. A live asset needs issuer identity and on-chain mint checks. Quotes belong to an exact amount and expire; changing your plan clears them. Pyth provides separate equity, token, and dollar references where available. Their timestamps and confidence matter. Stale references stay visibly stale. PreStocks has its own verified discovery and planning path. That doesn’t mean every asset has a supported purchase route. For supported mainnet execution, Lotline checks the transaction instructions, allowed programs, fees, wallet and expected output, then simulates the unsigned message. Your wallet still decides whether to sign. An uncertain result stops further approvals while the original signature is reconciled. A receipt needs confirmed on-chain evidence. The earlier unsigned simulation is documented separately. This walkthrough demonstrates the app and its safeguards, not a settled purchase.
